name: Progress
source:
Tamaki Konno was hired by an eco-energy developer to infiltrate Tachiritsu Umiha Academy and leak research secrets. 

Posing as a rookie teacher, "Mr. Konno" immediately caught the wrath of a gang of horned students called the Red Eyes. 

Their leader was rumored to have supernatural powers...... 

He couldn't believe the intense battles and heartpounding events going on at this utterly bizarre school---!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE123793.html]DLsite English[/url]]
